notes.heading: How it holds the shaft
notes.text: The revised coupler is pressed on C-101's shaft and held by one M3 × 4 cup-point grub screw (C-618), driven along +Y through an M3 nut captured in N2 onto the shaft's flat. The screw's thrust holds the nut on the pocket's outer face. The screw and nut are not part of this render: base_assembly and armbody_assembly draw them in place.

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The revised render is shown; toggle the reference and the previous render to compare. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, so it hides the mesh entirely, and the labels marked Previous name its features. The revised part is a different, round part (DC-600-2 in specs/009): a grip on the shaft, a body that ends under C-201's wave generator hub, a cone up to a Ø6 stub that runs up the generator's through-bore past its set screws, with the stub's and shaft bore's press fits and the grub screw's and nut's slip fits. The labels marked Revised name its features. The dimensions and fits are in 630-004_WaveGenCoupler.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
